title: JejakBahari
subtitle: Open RoRo Vessel Tracking for Indonesia
shortDescription: A free, open-source web app showing live positions, status, and movement history of Indonesian RoRo vessels from AIS data.
longDescription: JejakBahari is a free, open-source web app for tracking Indonesian RoRo vessels — live position, status, and movement history built on AIS data. The platform combines a live map of whitelisted vessels with master data for operators, vessels, ports, and routes, plus geofence-based arrival and departure detection. It is designed to stay lightweight, cheap to run, and easy for a community to maintain.
problem: Indonesian RoRo and maritime visibility depends on scattered public data sources for vessels, ports, and routes — AIS data can be delayed, missing, or wrong, and no free public tracker focuses on RoRo.
solution: An open platform that joins live AIS positions with vessel, port, and route master data — a live map of whitelisted RoRo vessels with data-freshness indicators, geofence-based arrival/departure detection, and an admin panel for verification.
responsibilities: Authored the documentation set — PRD, MVP scope, tech stack, architecture, sprint plan
Built the Laravel REST API — master data, position ingestion, whitelist, audit log
Built the Vue 3 frontend — MapLibre live map, search, vessel detail
Wrote the Node.js AIS worker — WebSocket client with Zod-validated payloads
Set up the PostGIS schema, geofence port events, and CI
features: Live map of whitelisted RoRo vessels
Vessel and port search with data-freshness indicators
Limited position history and movement trail
Admin panel for master data and verification
Explicit disclaimer — not a navigation or safety tool

decisions.title: Whitelist over full feed
decisions.rationale: Showing only verified RoRo vessels keeps the map honest and the scope maintainable.

decisions.title: Freshness as a feature
decisions.rationale: AIS data can be late or wrong — the UI surfaces data age instead of pretending precision.

decisions.title: Cheap and open
decisions.rationale: A lightweight Laravel + Vue + PostGIS stack on a single VPS keeps the project community-maintainable.

impact: Designed as a reusable open maritime-data foundation for Indonesian RoRo visibility
